evals.name: mixed-batch-typical
evals.prompt: I have an open PR for the current branch (PR #42). Please go through the review comments and deal with them.
evals.expected_output: Skill identifies PR #42, fetches 4 review + 1 issue comment, filters out the user's own comment and the CI bot notification, leaving 4 actionable items. Recommends ADDRESS for typo fix, ADDRESS for response validation, DECLINE for the RTK Query rewrite (out of scope), ADDRESS for adding a test. Applies fixes in separate commits (typo / validation / test), replies to each thread with short SHA, posts a polite decline reply to the architecture suggestion.

evals.name: filter-resolved-and-self
evals.prompt: Please review PR comments and fix them. Use PR #55.
evals.expected_output: Skill identifies PR #55. Of 5 review comments it fetches, 2 are resolved threads and 1 is the user's own — those are filtered out. The remaining 2 actionable items (debounce return type, trim() suggestion) are presented for triage. Skill does NOT triage resolved or self-authored comments.

evals.name: grouping-and-nuanced-triage
evals.prompt: I want to address the feedback on PR #78. Can you help me go through it?
evals.expected_output: Skill identifies PR #78, fetches 4 review comments. Recommends grouping comments 1 and 2 (both about the discount map refactor — same underlying fix). Recommends CLARIFY for comment 3 (frank-pm's vague 'feels off' — not enough info to act on). Recommends DEFER for comment 4 (grace-architect's split into PricingService/OrderValidator — valid but scope creep). Drafts appropriate replies for each category.
